risk_note: RV2 identity payout account (withdraw lane B2-05j; model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator D10-330). payout_account_changes.limit_exempt_reason (04 §3.2; 08 BR-WDR-02 细则「实名更正后的失效与重绑」): migration pair — ADD COLUMN limit_exempt_reason text NULL plus CHECK (NULL or 'realname_correction') NOT VALID, validated by the next migration (precedent 0079 / 0080); the table stays append-only (trigger unchanged, no UPDATE / DELETE grant for anyone, couli_app SELECT / INSERT only). identity's monthly change count (changesThisMonth, the 30303 payout_account_change_limit rule and change_remaining_this_month) now counts only rows whose limit_exempt_reason IS NULL. New port createPayoutAccountInvalidation().invalidate(trx, { appId, userId, operator, now }) for the customer-service realname correction (admin B1-27g): inside the caller's transaction that already holds the users row lock, every current payout_accounts row of the user (at most one by the partial unique index) is set is_current=false by row_version CAS (updated_at = now) and one change row is appended per retired row (old_* from that row, new_payout_method = the old method, new_hmac = '' meaning no new account, operator as given, changed_at = now, limit_exempt_reason = 'realname_correction'); no current row → nothing written, { retired: 0 }. The user's first rebinding afterwards is a first binding (no current row), writes no change row and is not counted even when the month's quota is used up ([AC-B2-05j#10]). No amounts are touched; instants come from the caller / the injected Clock; logs carry no payee data. Migration numbers are placeholders until the migration slot (main max + 1 / + 2 at landing).
